gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans reads modern and crisp, its lowercase rising close to cap height. Woodgod takes the vintage, commanding role with wide channels into every bowl, and its tall lowercase nearly matches the sans below.
gen-flavors-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Whimsical lettering from Flavors stands tall, its diagonals carrying just as much heft as the stems. Flavors grabs attention; BhuTuka Expanded One slows to a literary, leisurely walk.
gen-fs-kalam-cabin: Hand-drawn and cozy, Kalam huddles its lines tightly together. Kalam is for charm; Cabin, with its bent-tubing sans letters and open terminals, handles warm, gentle reading in modest amounts.
gen-fs-kalam-nunito-sans: Kalam looks hand-drawn and cozy, its lines tightly bundled. Nunito Sans, with open-mouthed curves, feels soft and gentle, though it is happiest over a brief spell of text rather than many pages.
gen-fs-pencerio-newsreader: A calligraphic hand gives Pencerio its graceful, formal air, with words fitted close and clenched. Newsreader handles the refined, authoritative reading, leaving Pencerio to do its best work in a line or two.
gen-fs-pencerio-nunito-sans: Graceful and formal, Pencerio is a calligraphic hand with clenched word shapes. It earns its keep big and short, never in paragraphs, while Nunito Sans, a soft sans-serif with open-mouthed curves, supplies the quieter words.
gen-fs-rosaline-dm-sans: DM Sans reads friendly, with wide-set terminals on its s, made for brief reading. And Rosaline brings the luxury, with stems far thicker than its crossbars, so let the body text stay modest in size.
gen-fs-telma-instrument-sans: Loose, flowing pen strokes with a wide-mouthed a. Telma sets that handwritten ease against Instrument Sans, a sans-serif whose uniform strokes stay crisp, though neither is built for lengthy paragraphs.
gen-fs-telma-inter: Graceful pen strokes give Telma a wide-mouthed a and a high mean line running across every word. Inter sits crisp and tube-smooth beside that script, best with brief text.
gen-gf-agu-display-fs-rowan: Looped, bent-wire strokes make Agu Display instantly distinctive. Rowan brings generous, friendly curves for reading, and the wire-bent drama against that warmth is the standout, though not for long paragraphs.
